usage: agentbreeder registry publish [-h] [--to TO]
                                     [--dry-run | --expect-digest SHA256]
                                     [--json]
                                     source

positional arguments:
  source

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --to TO               Registry root
  --dry-run             Check and hash a staged copy; write nothing
  --expect-digest SHA256
                        Refuse unless the staged copy has this digest (from
                        --dry-run)
  --json
